original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 21 Built-in Pointing Device structure on the intended SUT against the approved platform specification.
original_method: Through protected read-only OS access, capture complete raw Type 21 output and exit status, parse every handle and its device type/interface/button fields, compare to the expected inventory and preserve raw-to-parsed evidence.
manual_activity: The BIOS/platform owner supplies the expected built-in pointing-device inventory and field semantics; an operator verifies target identity and protected access while automation performs complete collection and comparison.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS and SMBIOS version
Expected Type 21 handle count and built-in device inventory
Expected device type, interface, button count and applicable optional/vendor fields
Supported dmidecode/parser version and normalization rules
Protected credential/host verification and evidence storage
Policy for absent, extra, duplicate, unknown and not-provided values
safety_requirements: Keep collection strictly read-only; do not change BIOS or input-device configuration
Do not clear logs before preserving relevant baseline evidence
Never place passwords on the command line or disable host-key verification
Capture complete stdout, stderr and exit status; do not use a heading-only grep as verdict evidence
Bind output to SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/parser identity and timestamp
Stop on malformed/truncated data or unknown semantics and require owner interpretation
Do not issue the final hardware verdict automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate target and expected Type 21 matrix
Collect complete raw `dmidecode --type 21` through protected access
Parse every structure, handle and defined field without dropping duplicates
Apply only documented enum and not-provided semantics
Compare absent, extra and mismatched entries and retain raw-to-parsed mapping
Report the comparison without system mutation or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the expected device inventory and Type 21 field semantics
Resolve OEM, unknown or absent-entry interpretation
Confirm any read-only hardware/input cross-check needed
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 21 selector matches the source, but grep can omit fields or multiple entries and the sshpass/disabled-host-key wrapper is not acceptable protected evidence handling.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected authenticated access to run `dmidecode --type 21` without filtering, retaining complete stdout/stderr, exit status, target identity and parser version before field-level comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 21 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: TYPE21 SPEC MATRIX AND PROTECTED COMPLETE READ REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse each raw Type 21 structure by handle and compare device type, interface, button count and supported fields against the exact platform inventory, preserving unknown/not-provided values rather than dropping them.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds full multi-entry capture, secure access, target/parser binding and explicit field semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A filtered heading proves only that a decoder emitted a label; it does not prove entry count or field correctness.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some server platforms legitimately expose no built-in pointing device; absence is acceptable only when the owner matrix explicitly says so.

project_override_considerations: An approved raw SMBIOS parser may replace dmidecode if it demonstrates equivalent Type 21 decoding and retains the raw table; generic OS input-device inventory is supplemental rather than SMBIOS coverage.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode identity, timestamp and approved Type 21 matrix
Complete raw Type 21 stdout/stderr and exit status
Parsed handle, device type, interface, buttons and all applicable fields
Optional read-only input identity cross-check plus no-mutation/security audit
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target SMBIOS Type 21 Built-in Pointing Device data. Missing expected values and enum policy are project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Type 21 reader and comparison are deterministic once the platform field matrix, protected access and parser are supplied.

review_improvement: Retains the correct DeepSeek type selector while replacing incomplete filtered output and unsafe access with complete, identity-bound field-level evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Type 21 record can be absent, singular or repeated, and its semantic value is in the device/interface/button fields—not the decoder heading. Therefore the acceptance unit is the complete handle-indexed inventory matched to the platform spec, including explicit absence expectations.
